theme.description:
A web-accessibility–focused style for eXeLearning 4 designed to be compatible with Universal Design for Learning (UDL) principles. Created by Ignacio Gros for EducaMadrid.
iDevice icons: "EducaAnd Escolares" style, by Consejería de Educación y Deporte (https://moocedu.juntadeandalucia.es/) for eXeLearning (http://exelearning.net/), cofinanced by FEDER funds.

Navigation icons by Google (https://fonts.google.com/icons), under the 2.0 version of the Apache License (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html).
License badges (img/licenses.gif): Creative Commons license buttons, by Creative Commons (https://creativecommons.org/).
